name: ai-screen-recorder-desktop
description: Windows-first AI Screen Recorder desktop application

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:5173 file:dist-electron/main/main.js && cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron .
scripts.verify:lockfile: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('package-lock.json')){console.error('Missing package-lock.json. Run npm install and commit the lockfile.'); process.exit(1);} console.log('Lockfile present.');"
scripts.build: npm run prepare:ffmpeg && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main
